spec.description: Out-of-the-box Docker Hub connector. Resolves a durable Docker Hub Personal Access Token through the x-dapr-secret credential mechanism (leased via the connector sidecar) and shapes a data-plane ConnectorContext for OCI pull/push/list activities against registry-1.docker.io. The plugin never sees the resolved PAT and never mints registry bearer tokens — bind emits a placeholder the sidecar substitutes, and the per-repository Layer-2 token exchange against auth.docker.io is performed by the consuming activity (see design/architecture/registry-credential-refresh.md).
